name: Box Filter Dye Advection
definition: Use of a simple box filter instead of a Hanning windowed filter to create natural dye advection effects, allowing easier control over dye concentration and motion via phase shifting.
summary: Box Filter Dye Advection is a Line Integral Convolution variation using a box filter and phase shift to animate dye along vector field streamlines, differing from standard LIC by its temporal motion capability.
